## Getting started

This is a Quarto (`.qmd`) file. It mixes **text** and **R code**.

When I render it, Quarto runs the code and builds an HTML page.

## Math in R

```{r}
2 + 2
sqrt(16)
mean(c(10, 20, 30))
```

## A tiny plot

```{r}
#| label: mpg-hist
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of mpg in mtcars"

hist(mtcars$mpg,
     main = "Miles per gallon",
     xlab = "mpg",
     col = "steelblue",
     border = "white")
```
